about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm a web developer who enjoys turning ideas into products people actually want to use. Below is a bit more about how I work and what I bring to a project.
about.whyBuildText: I build web apps because I like solving real problems with code — taking something messy or manual and turning it into something simple, fast, and reliable. Every project is a chance to learn something new and to make someone's day a little easier.
about.workWithClientText: I believe good software comes from good communication. I listen carefully to what a client actually needs, keep them updated at every step, and I'm not afraid to push back with a better idea when I see one. The goal is always a result the client is proud to show off.
